component.name: Superwebby
component.summary: Painless privacy-first web browser with a real Ctrl+J downloads panel

description.p: Superwebby is a privacy-first desktop web browser with a real Ctrl+J downloads panel, then pushed further so everyday browsing stays out of your way. It draws pages with Qt WebEngine and wraps its own chrome, shortcuts, blocking, and internal pages around that engine.

There is no telemetry, crash phone-home, sign-in nag, or first-run wizard. A bundled ad and tracker list is applied from the first request, downloads land quietly in your Downloads folder, dark mode turns on by itself, and common cookie banners are dismissed for you.

ul.li: Ctrl+J downloads shelf, the way Brave used to work
Command palette (Ctrl+K) that searches tabs, history, and commands
Built-in ad and tracker blocking with a shield badge
Session restore without asking, plus private windows
Tabbed browsing, omnibox, and session restore
Ctrl+J downloads panel and Ctrl+K command palette
Bundled ad and tracker blocking, auto dark mode, and cookie-banner dismissal
